derivation: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G2278 (ἠχέω);
def: to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported)

occurrences.text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
